input: Exact same serialized and ordered 2,304 edited-route development inputs as period one. These are repeated observations, not new decisions or a second accuracy sample.
primary: On each physical slot compare the compact two-visit CUDA time with the full split-only CUDA time at the same per-row tokens, 18 linear plus 6 full-attention layer calls and one coda. Report the geometric mean of the two slot-specific ratios of mean per-decision CUDA-event times.
secondary: Report same-k stock and two-visit ratios separately, and the numerical repeatability of each fixed payload/method on each slot. Do not count the repetition as independent quality evidence.

resampling.unit: whole original graph within each generator seed, shared across both slots

limitations: One execution per method, period and slot on two specific devices, batch size one; intervals describe input-mix uncertainty, not repeated-hardware or deployment uncertainty. Cold loads, whole-device VRAM and batched throughput are separate quantities.
